coverage.row: Acceptance 1: defaults 600000/100, positive overrides, actual per-send counters and admission semantics.
Acceptance 2: every native/synthetic final path, complete 16KiB envelope, retained effects and closed consumer grammar.
Acceptance 3: reserve maximum heading width, stable capped body, real remaining counters and reset on send.
Acceptance 4: exact overlapping count/first10 lines/whitespace hint inside authoritative transform; no fuzzy write or patch regression.
Acceptance 5: third identical canonical call/result steers and emits notice; fourth executes; changed sequence/reset clear; sends/model switches retain.
Acceptance 6: successful write/edit/patch gets host diagnostics, bounded count; unavailable/pending/rejection/deletion explicit; standalone retained.
Acceptance 7: one bounded wait across changed paths, late resolution/rejection cannot mutate receipt, admitted mutation settles before Stop.
Acceptance 8: shared default v2 recipe, opt-out affects only recipe, trace boolean, original paragraphs/resource ordering, actual native benchmark wire.
Acceptance 9: public 600s default, real diagnostics/steering on next model request, image/switch/recovery/policy/effects baseline.
Parity 1: actual native Agent/MemoryVfs end receipts reach history/next wire for valid/invalid/missing calls; steering preserves fourth effect.
Parity 2: real Workbench TypeScript source through standalone diagnostics and mutation receipts, error then repair.
Parity 3: common recipe reaches actual native SDK extension and Rifty wire; opt-out removes recipe.
Fault native settlement/provenance-lie: invalid/missing/blocked/cancelled receipts without invented execution; effects unchanged.
Fault result formatting/lossy-aggregate: Unicode/long metadata/budget widths preserve complete bounded JSON, stable body and explicit truncation.
Fault exact edit/concurrent-same-key: locating diagnostics use the host transform read and never fuzzy-write.
Fault sequence/sibling-drift: reordered JSON args compare equal, nested budget-named result data remains significant.
Fault diagnostics/unbounded-read: delayed or stalled boundary has one deadline, pending result and no late mutation/rejection.
Fault diagnostics/false-fallback: missing/rejected service and deleted paths explicitly unavailable, completed mutation remains successful.
Preserved I12: actual event metrics, including budget-blocked proposal excluded from executed tools; frozen config/tasks/judges unchanged.
